policies.name: BraveRewardsDisabled
policies.reason: Ads-for-crypto program; not used. Removes the Rewards prompts.

policies.name: BraveWalletDisabled
policies.reason: Crypto wallet and web3/decentralized DNS are not used; smaller attack surface.

policies.name: BraveVPNDisabled
policies.reason: Paid VPN upsell; Tailscale is the family's network path.

policies.name: BraveAIChatEnabled
policies.reason: Jason uses separate AI tools; Leo's sidebar and prompts are redundant.

policies.name: BraveStatsPingEnabled
policies.reason: Privacy: no daily usage ping. Browser updates do not use this ping.

policies.name: PasswordManagerEnabled
policies.reason: The built-in password manager does not compete with Bitwarden. Same rule Groundwork used for Chrome.

extensions.name: Bitwarden
extensions.reason: The only extension Groundwork offers, on every OS.

notes.reason: Jason decided on 2026-10-29 to stick with Bitwarden only. No AI or other extensions are offered.
